description: This file defines the MenuLinkContentInterface interface for Drupal, specifying methods related to custom menu links, including properties like title, URL, menu name, description, plugin ID, enabled/expanded status, parent ID, weight, plugin definition, and rediscovery requirements.

methods.name: setInsidePlugin
methods.description: Flags this instance as being wrapped in a menu link plugin instance.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Gets the title of the menu link.

methods.name: getUrlObject
methods.description: Gets the URL object pointing to the URL of the menu link content entity.

methods.name: getMenuName
methods.description: Gets the menu name of the custom menu link.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of the menu link for the UI.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Gets the menu plugin ID associated with this entity.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the menu link is marked as enabled.

methods.name: isExpanded
methods.description: Returns whether the menu link is marked as always expanded.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Gets the plugin ID of the parent menu link.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the menu link content entity.

methods.name: getPluginDefinition
methods.description: Builds up the menu link plugin definition for this entity.

methods.name: requiresRediscovery
methods.description: Returns whether the menu link requires rediscovery.

methods.name: setRequiresRediscovery
methods.description: Flags a link as requiring rediscovery.
